note: The owner's private projects, which a public repository must not name. Held as hashes so this file does not publish what it guards: FNV-1a, 64 bits, of the lowercase name, as hex. A word in a text is split on anything that is not a letter, a digit or a hyphen, lowercased, hashed and compared. The garden's own tools may be named. To add a name, hash it with scripts/public_names.py --hash <name>.
